headline: Hassan district study shows child undernutrition in rural South Karnataka areas
summary: Hassan district in South Karnataka has documented child undernutrition issues in its rural areas. A study conducted in two remote villages of Hassan and Kodagu districts examined preschool children (160 boys, 140 girls) selected through stratified sampling, focusing on undernutrition and anemia prevalence among under-five children. The research highlights that despite accelerated growth, hunger, poor health status, undernutrition and child mortality persist in rural parts of South Karnataka. However, specific district-level stunting rates and intervention details for Hassan are not provided in available sources.

reasons.detail: Study specifically targeted remote villages in Hassan district where undernutrition and child mortality persist despite overall development.
Research documented poor health status among preschool children in Hassan's rural areas as a continuing challenge.
